column1: # The signal panel rows of this model (apps/core/lumen-signal README.md), in the app as assets/lumen_signal/items.tsv.
# One row per vendor read the panel may make here, read only while the panel is on screen, at most 2 calls per second.
# A model without a row never shows that line. Columns (tab separated): item (SignalItem token), call, note.
# Play 6: no checked getter of the picture on the chip, so no chip row and no judder line.
